title: Product Manager
Senior Manager - Global Product Ops Excellence (All Genders)
description:
The role 
 From day one you’ll enable international coordination and implementation of strategic product priorities by creating, standardising and optimising processes across central and local physical product teams and other stakeholders. The role will require a mix of process improvement, change management, technical understanding, project management and stakeholder management skills. Not only will you be an ambassador of Product Operations Excellence, but also champion the value of process automation and optimization, to set a solid basis for growth.
 Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you. 
 What you’ll do 
 Shape the operating model: Diagnose end-to-end processes across central and local Product teams and adjacent functions (Procurement, FSQA, Production). 
 Design and scale standards: Own process frameworks, SOPs and rollout "golden standards" that teams across markets adopt. Challenge and iterate existing policies and guidelines when they no longer fit the business.
 Lead cross-market change: Drive organizational change across markets and functions, balancing central consistency with local needs. Build alignment with senior stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and ensure a constant flow of information.
 Lead programs and automation: Own complex automation and tooling initiatives from a commercial perspective. Sign off on tooling designs and business cases, guide Tech teams on scope, edge cases and interdependencies, and take part in Steering Committees. On top of that, identify where AI can reshape Product Operations processes, build the business cases and prototypes, and deploy the successful tools across markets and teams. 
 Lead under uncertainty: Scope and drive short- and long-term programs from broadly defined outcomes. Develop plan Bs and alternative solutions when priorities shift, and turn ambiguous problems into manageable, measurable workstreams.
 What you’ll bring 
 5+ years minimum experience in Product Operations or Operational/Process Excellence; passion for food or experience within Food/FMCG industry or consultancy is a plus
 Recognized expertise in process excellence, change management and program delivery, with advanced knowledge of methodologies, current best practices and industry trends. You continuously challenge the status quo and bring new ideas to life.
 Highly numerate and commercially minded, able to build rigorous, objective business cases and to judge technical designs with confidence.
 A strong stakeholder leader who manages global and local stakeholders at all levels, aligns teams across markets, and communicates clearly to different audiences.
 Autonomous and outcome-driven: you manage scope and timelines independently, prioritize relentlessly, and are comfortable being challenged on the soundness of your work.
 Thrives in a fast-paced, demanding and data-driven environment. 
 Curious about AI and automation: you actively explore how AI can reshape processes, assess its impact rigorously, and lead teams to adopt it where it creates measurable value.
 Bachelor's or Master's degree from a top-tier university, preferably in business, management, operations or a related field. Six Sigma Belt or PMP certification is a big plus. 
 What we offer 
 Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.
 2 years contract.
 Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
 Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
 Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
 Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
 Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!
 About HelloFresh 
 HelloFresh is on a mission to change the way people eat, forever! 
 Since our 2011 founding in Europe’s vibrant tech hub, Berlin, we’ve become the world's leading meal kit provider, delivering to over 4.2 million households worldwide in 15 countries across 3 continents.  
 Our more than 15,000 employees from over 70+ nationalities are the heart and soul of our diverse, fast-paced and dynamic environment where innovation and smart, fast action is encouraged.  
 We will encourage you to make an immediate impact in your area of work as well as empower you to grow your career with us. 
 Are you up for the challenge? 
 Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date. 
 After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.  
 We are HelloFresh 
 At HelloFresh we embrace and welcome diversity and we currently employ over 15,000 individuals globally who contribute to this. We employ individuals based on their ability to perform a job rather than on the basis of their: race, national origin, color, caste, social origin or position, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, political opinion, marital status or any other characteristic. We encourage everyone to apply and will give everyone equal consideration. We are an equal opportunity employer – everyone is welcome at our table.

title: Staff Product Manager, Tenant Scale
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 
 An overview of this role 
 As a Staff Product Manager on the Tenant Scale area within Infrastructure Platforms, you’ll set product direction for how GitLab supports large, complex customers as they grow across departments, projects, and regions. This role focuses on the product choices needed to make tenant data more portable, scalable, and ready for a unified deployment model across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and, over time, Self-Managed. You’ll work on problems that sit at the intersection of product strategy, infrastructure, and customer needs, including how we build a platform to horizontally scale our SaaS architecture, how to enable tenant movement between environments, how isolation and regional requirements are handled, and what needs to be in place to support a more cellular architecture.
 At the Staff level, your scope extends beyond a single group. Your direction will inform the broader Infrastructure Platforms direction, you’ll make the investment case for unified deployment capabilities, and you’ll be a recognized authority, inside and outside GitLab, on multi-tenant and cellular SaaS architecture. In your first year, you’ll partner closely with engineering and product peers to define requirements, drive alignment, and move this work from concept into a deployment model teams can build on, while coaching fellow product managers as they pick up work from the shared pool.
 What you’ll do 
 Drive product strategy and direction for tenant scale and unified deployment capabilities across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and future deployment models, informing the broader Infrastructure Platforms direction and moving this work from concept into a deployment model teams can build on in your first year.
 Set quarterly and annual plans for tenant portability and platform unification, breaking large epics into issues and minimal valuable changes (MVCs) and practicing iteration across multiple groups.
 Define requirements for our unified deployment platform, including the capabilities needed before tenants can be hosted in a unified deployment unit.
 Partner closely with engineering counterparts and highly technical teams to turn infrastructure constraints and platform needs into clear product direction.
 Collaborate with product peers across the platforms organization, including teams working on GitLab.com and adjacent infrastructure areas, and manage with influence to align work that spans more than one group.
 Engage with internal and external customers to understand needs related to isolation, regional deployment, compliance, and operational readiness, using qualitative interviews to find patterns and sharpen problem statements.
 Build business cases for investment in tenant scale and unified deployment, including build, buy, and partner options, the cost of isolation, regionality, and compliance, and the expected benefits.
 Facilitate tradeoff discussions around scalability, tenant encapsulation, deployment consistency, and platform unification, and escalate cleanly to the right level of leadership when decisions or progress are blocked.
 Translate complex technical concepts into product plans, priorities, and documentation that align distributed teams on delivery milestones for tenant portability and platform unification, using error budgets and other performance indicators to inform direction.
 Represent GitLab as a trusted voice on cellular architecture and tenant scale in customer calls, events, and other external forums.
 Coach fellow product managers on direction updates, customer validation, and GitLab’s architecture and tech stack, and support a collaborative team model where product managers share ownership across a common pool of work and step into the areas where they can have the most impact.
 What you’ll bring 
 Experience managing product work in technical domains such as infrastructure, scalability, platform architecture, software delivery, or cloud services, with results delivered across a range of product areas rather than a single one.
 Ability to work effectively with deeply technical engineering teams and build credibility in discussions about system design, deployment models, and platform constraints.
 Knowledge of how SaaS or platform-based systems scale, including concepts such as multitenancy, horizontal scalability, autoscaling, workload isolation, and production readiness, and the ability to build a deep understanding of GitLab’s architecture and tech stack and coach others on it.
 Comfort working with customers or internal stakeholders on complex requirements, including operational, compliance, or regional deployment needs.

title: Senior Product Manager | Integrations & AI Foundations (f/m/d)
description:
bunch https://www.bunch.capital/ is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.
YOUR ROLE
As Senior Product Manager for Integrations & AI Foundations, you're the product owner for bunch's integration and AI platform. You have two kinds of customers: external developers and fund-manager teams connecting to bunch, and the internal product teams building on top of what this team provides.
Integrations & AI Foundations is a new platform squad. It owns the infrastructure that lets data move securely between bunch and other systems, and lets every other product team build AI capabilities — extraction, retrieval, agents and evaluations — without each one solving the same hard problems again.
The team covers five connected areas:
 - Integrations / API layer — API contracts, authentication, versioning and deprecation, rate limits, uptime and SLA, and a Developer Portal
 - MCP layer — agent-callable tools built as thin wrappers over the same API contracts, including a customer-facing MCP offering
 - Document Parsing — a reusable ingestion, decomposition and extraction pipeline, with human-in-the-loop review and accuracy monitoring
 - Retrieval / RAG — chunking, embedding, vector store and retrieval, with access control enforced on every query, offered as a callable service
 - AI Agentic Layer — the agent framework, memory, guardrails, evaluation harness, observability and agent registry other teams use to ship their own agents
Document extraction, agent workflows, evaluations and multi-provider model fallback under EU data residency are already in production. 
Fund managers don't want to retype data that already lives in their own systems, and they want to pull their bunch data into their own tools and their own AI. Customers and prospects ask for APIs, CRM and accounting syncs, automated exports of capital accounts, and MCP access. 
You'll turn those signals into a coherent platform: one that customers integrate with, and that our own product teams build on, instead of a string of one-off builds.
You will:
 - Set platform strategy and sequencing across the five areas: decide how to slice the work and what ships first
 - Run APIs as a product: contracts, versioning and deprecation policy, rate limits, SLAs, Developer Portal and documentation, and time-to-integrate as a measure you actively drive down
 - Define and launch the customer-facing MCP offering: which capabilities get exposed, tool descriptions that agents actually invoke correctly, and a security review gate for anything customers touch
 - Generalise document parsing: the first use case is already live; your goal will be to take it over and generalise it so more teams can reuse its logic
 - Shape retrieval and the agentic layer as services other teams consume, with access control, guardrails, evaluations and observability built in rather than bolted on
 - Draw and hold ownership lines with domain teams. When a request doesn't map to a named responsibility, run the scoping conversation rather than absorbing it
 - Own platform-wide policy with Engineering and Security: data classification and residency, LLM cost and rate governance, and an integration and extraction registry so nothing gets built twice
 - Work directly with customers — fund managers, CFOs and their technical teams — and with Customer Success to understand integration needs, then turn them into platform decisions
 - Define success through goals and key results and clear metrics per area: API uptime and SLA, time-to-integrate, MCP adoption, extraction accuracy, and reuse across teams.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
In your first 90 days
 - Resolve and document the MCP audience, governance model, and hand-off point between platform and domain teams
 - Agree a plan and timeline for moving extraction from the existing team onto the shared pipeline
 - Define a sequenced first slice, with baseline metrics for each area
In your first year
 - A versioned public API and Developer Portal that customers integrate with
 - A customer-facing MCP offering live
 - Multiple domain teams extracting from their documents on the shared pipeline, shipping an agent on the agentic layer, without having to run a separate vector store or having to rebuild extraction from scratch
ABOUT YOU
 - 6+ years in product management, with at least 3 on platform, API or developer-facing products in B2B SaaS
 - You've shipped and run public APIs: REST or GraphQL, OAuth and other authentication patterns, versioning, deprecation, and docs developers actually like
 - Hands-on experience shipping LLM features to production, whether extraction, RAG or agents. You understand evaluations, confidence scoring, failure modes and human-in-the-loop review, and can hold your own with Applied AI engineers on chunking, embeddings and model fallback
 - Working knowledge of MCP or agent tool-use, and a clear view on what makes a tool safe and reliable for an agent to call
 - Strong instincts for security and compliance with regulated data: access control, GDPR and data residency
 - You lead through influence. You're comfortable with internal teams as customers and can say no, or not us, clearly and with reasons
 - You write clearly and document decisions so others can build on them
Nice to have
 - Fintech, fund administration or private markets experience: capital calls, capital accounts, subscription documents, LP and portfolio reporting
 - Experience in an EU-regulated environment
 - You've built a Developer Portal or a partner integrations programme from zero
 - You've moved a capability out of one team and into a shared platform without breaking either side
 - Experience in a company moving from ops-led to product-led

title: Lead Product Manager - Patient Data Collection (x/f/m)
description:
SET A NEW PULSE FOR HEALTHCARE!
We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to join the Patient Profile team in the Patient domain.
Your mission will be to make the patient health record complete, accurate and current enough that everything else we build can act on it, the health recommendations, care plans and assistant experiences that help people take their health into their own hands. You will work in a feature team developing the Patient Health Record, health trackers, patient account and online identity, contributing directly to the quality of the medical support we provide to both patients and practitioners. 
A patient record is built from four channels: what patients enter themselves, what they share when preparing a consultation, what we retrieve from health professionals' systems, and what they connect from third-party sources such as Apple Health, Google Health Connect and national health record services. Three of those channels belong to teams you will not manage. You will own the outcome across all four, the most leveraged place to sit in a health platform, and only reachable through other people.
You will also work inside a hard regulatory perimeter: health data, GDPR, consent by design. 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:
 - Own the end-to-end patient data collection programme across every channel a patient record is built from, and be accountable for the result across all four
 - Define what a useful record actually means for the teams that depend on it, make that definition measurable, and instrument it rather than inheriting a dashboard
 - Partner with the channel-owning teams inside and outside the group: set the inter-team contracts, agree how each channel contributes, and arbitrate collection priorities
 - Own record quality and freshness rather than volume, alongside health data storage consent, patient account and online identity
 - Ship the layers that serve this data to the rest of the product: the patient feature store, the patient context service and the Patient Health Record feature
 - Lead the Patient Profile team's roadmap and delivery, from PHR (patient health record) and trackers through to the feature store and context service
WHO YOU ARE
Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.
You'll be a great fit if you:
 - You have owned a coverage, completeness or data quality metric as your primary objective, and can say what it went from, to what, and over how long
 - You have worked at millions-of-records scale
 - You have moved that metric through teams that did not report to you, setting interfaces, contracts and SLAs with partner teams
 - You have shipped under a hard regulatory or consent constraint, in health, finance or identity, with privacy and consent by design
 - You have real technical depth: you have owned a data platform component as a product, a feature store, a context or profile service, or an identity layer. 
 - You are fluent in English
It would be fantastic if you:
 - You have had a data quality problem surface only once it reached a downstream consumer, and you changed how you worked because of it
 - You have built a completeness or quality definition and made an organisation adopt it
 - You have worked on interoperability, health data standards, or identity and account models

 - 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT
 - Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care
 - Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

 - A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page https://careers.doctolib.com/tech-doctolib/getting-hired/.
JOB DETAILS
 - Permanent position

 - Hybrid work setup (2 remote days per week)
 - Start date: as soon as possible
WE WELCOME EVERYONE
At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.
The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.
To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

title: Senior Product Manager - Content Integrity
description:
**Why This Role**
-----------------
AVIV Group runs some of Europe’s largest property marketplaces, including SeLoger, immowelt and Immoweb. Users make one of the biggest financial decisions of their lives based on what they see there, and that only works if the content is real, accurate and current. You will own content integrity: the products that decide whether a listing is authentic and compliant, what happens when it isn’t, and how that signal steers visibility and liquidity. This is a founding role, with the opportunity to define the product strategy.
**The Team You’ll Join**
------------------------
You’ll join Trust & Safety as a founding member, working with engineering, data science and operations. You’ll partner closely with Search, Recommendations and Notifications, and with external BPOs on quality and guidelines. This is a central team, so you’ll also work with our country organisations, who choose whether to adopt what you build.
**What You’ll Own**
-------------------
* **Strategy and roadmap:** Set the vision for trustworthy listing content and turn it into a prioritised roadmap, delivered end to end with engineering, data science and operations.
* **Detection products:** Own the ML and rules-based systems that catch misleading behaviour and policy violations, including the precision/recall trade-off and the evidence of what the system misses.
* **Integrity as a ranking signal:** Turn integrity judgements into signals that shape visibility, and decide when to remove, demote, warn or do nothing.
* **Enforcement experience:** Own what users are told when content is actioned, how they fix it and how they appeal.
* **Moderation and compliance platform:** Own the review tooling, queues and automation that let a small operations team work consistently at volume, and translate written policy into enforceable product logic.
* **Metrics and adoption:** Define and baseline the domain metrics, then move them, and drive adoption across our country organisations.
**What We’ll Achieve Together**
-------------------------------
Success means measurable improvements, not just new processes. We expect you to help us:
* Reduce the prevalence of violating content and users’ exposure to it.
* Improve detection precision and recall, with results that can be independently verified.
* Increase the automation rate and shorten time to action.
* Keep the appeal overturn rate under control as enforcement scales.
* Get markets to choose and adopt the tools you build.
*The exact measures will be agreed based on the priorities and baseline when you join.*
**What You Bring**
------------------
We care more about what you have built and improved than a particular title. You bring:
* Around five years in product management, including ownership of ML or data products where you were accountable for model quality and decision thresholds.
* Experience in content integrity, marketplace quality or trust & safety at a consumer platform or marketplace.
* Work at the boundary of integrity and discovery, using quality or trust signals in search ranking, recommendations or feed visibility.
* A working partnership with policy and moderation operations, such as writing requirements for reviewers, building review tooling or auditing human decisions.
* Strong analytical judgement and clear written English.
**Nice to have:** French or German; familiarity with the EU Digital Services Act or comparable regimes; experience in a central platform model serving several brands or markets; an adversarial instinct for how a new feature will be gamed.
**How We Work at AVIV**

title: Product Manager (m/w/d) Billing, Payment & Pricing Platform
description:
Über uns
Rabot Energy ist ein unabhängiger Anbieter dynamischer Stromtarife für Haushalte und Unternehmen. Mit smarten Einkaufsstrategien und automatischer Steuerung verschieben wir flexiblen Verbrauch in Stunden mit niedrigen Börsenpreisen. So optimieren Haushalte und Unternehmen ihre Stromkosten. Unsere Vision ist es, allen Kund:innen die Möglichkeit zu geben, ihren Stromverbrauch smart zu steuern und von günstigen Börsenstunden zu profitieren.
Warum jetzt?
Bei einem dynamischen Stromtarif ist die Rechnung nicht das Ende des Produkts – sie ist das Produkt. Sie ist der Moment, in dem unser Versprechen überprüfbar wird: Hat der Kunde wirklich gespart? Ist der Preis nachvollziehbar? Stimmt der Abschlag? Die Billing-, Payment- und Pricing-Plattform ist damit das Backbone des Unternehmens : Jeder Tarif, jedes Asset, jeder Partner und jeder Euro Umsatz läuft durch sie – und sie ist einer der stärksten Hebel auf Vertrauen, Supportaufwand und Retention.
Die Plattform steht gut da. Jetzt kommt die nächste Phase: viertelstündliche Abrechnung, Live-Vermarktung von E-Autos und Batteriespeichern,
 14a EnWG im Regelbetrieb, neue Zahlungswege und automatisierte Forderungsprozesse – und eine wachsende Zahl an Partnern, die auf genau dieser Plattform abrechnen. Du übernimmst eine etablierte, gut dokumentierte Domain mit strukturiertem Handover. Zunächst im Co-Ownership während der Einarbeitung, anschließend in voller Eigenverantwortung.
 Deine Mission
Du verantwortest als Product Manager die Billing-, Payment- und Pricing-Plattform und damit die komplette User- und Daten-Journey von Kunden-Onboarding bis Abrechnung: Abrechnungsprozesse und Datenflüsse, Preisbestandteile, Abschläge, Billruns, Abrechnungsdokumente, Zahlungseinzug und Mandatslogik, Mahn- und Forderungsprozesse, Ratenzahlung und die billing-bezogene Kundenkommunikation.
Deine grundsätzliche Mission ist Plattformentwicklung. Unsere Plattform ist bereits eine echtes Powerhouse: Sie trägt unser gesamtes Kundenportfolio, mehrere Tarifwelten und externe Partner zuverlässig und skaliert. Auf diesem Fundament baust du weiter – du entscheidest, welche Anforderungen zu wiederverwendbaren Plattformfunktionen werden, und prägst so die Architektur der nächsten Jahre.
 Konkret Heißt Das
 Du ownst die Domain end to end. Du priorisierst mit einem festen Dev-Team, schreibst PRDs, refinest mit Engineering und bringst Releases live – von einzelnen Preiskorrekturen bis zu mehrmonatigen Plattform-Initiativen. 
 Du machst Abrechnung verständlich. Du arbeitest daran, dass Kund:innen Rechnung, Abschlag und Guthaben ohne Nachfrage verstehen.
 Du ownst Payrate und Open Balance. Zahlungseinzug endet nicht mit dem Rechnungsversand. Du verantwortest die Produkt-Hebel, die darauf wirken: automatisierte Mahnstufen, Auto-Allocation von Zahlungen und Gutschriften (älteste Forderung zuerst), Retry- und Mandatslogik im Zahlungseinzug sowie Ratenzahlung. Du steuerst Payrate und Open Balance als eigene Kennzahlen, nicht als Nebenprodukt der Abrechnung.
 Du baust Plattform, nicht nur Features. Abrechnungs- und Zahlungsservices, Preis- und Rechnungs-APIs: Du verantwortest Bausteine, auf denen andere Teams und Partner aufbauen – und entscheidest bewusst, wann eine Anforderung zur Plattformfunktion wird und wann nicht.
 Du ermöglichst neue Geschäftsmodelle. Live-Vermarktung von EVs und Batteriespeichern, Wärme-/Nachtspeichertarife und weitere Modelle scheitern oder gelingen an der Abrechenbarkeit.
 Du navigierst Regulatorik und Energiemarkt. 
 14a EnWG,
 41a und
 40/40c EnWG, MsbG, TAF7 vs. SLP, 15-Minuten-Day-Ahead, Netzentgeltreduktion, Marktkommunikation. Du übersetzt regulatorische Anforderungen in umsetzbare Produktentscheidungen.
 Du arbeitest AI-first. Wir nutzen AI-Tools für Analyse, Dokumentation, Datenchecks und wiederkehrende Prozesse. Von dir erwarten wir, dass du deinen eigenen Workflow damit schneller machst – nicht, dass du wartest, bis jemand ein Tool für dich baut.
 Du arbeitest eng mit Engineering, Customer Support, Operations, Finance/Controlling, BI, Legal, Partner Management, Sales und den anderen Product Squads zusammen und berichtest wöchentlich transparent an Team und Leadership.
Deine Ergebnisse
Wir denken in Ergebnissen, nicht in Aufgabenlisten. Wenn du erfolgreich bist, sieht das so aus:
 Monat 3 (Ramp-up)
 Du hast die Billing Journey von Onboarding bis Jahresabrechnung durchdrungen
 Du kennst unsere Tarifwelten und ihre Abrechnungslogik und kannst eine Rechnung Position für Position erklären.
 Du kennst die Payrate-Kette von der Rechnungsstellung bis zum Zahlungseingang und weißt, an welchen Stellen Geld liegen bleibt.
 Du hast deine ersten Änderungen live gebracht.
 Monat 6 (Performance)
 Du verantwortest die Roadmap der Plattform eigenständig und lieferst planbar.
 Du hast das Handover abgeschlossen und führst den Wochenrhythmus eigenständig: Priorisierung, Refinements, Reporting und Steering-Formate.
 Mahn- und Zahlungsprozesse laufen messbar automatisierter, und du führst Payrate und Open Balance im Wochenrhythmus wie eine eigene Roadmap.
 Monat 12 (Scale)
 Abrechnungsqualität und -verlässlichkeit sind auf einem Niveau, auf dem Billing zum Retention Driver wird – und Payrate und Open Balance liegen auf dem Niveau, das unseren Payback trägt und Wachstum finanzierbar macht.
 Wen wir suchen
Diese Rolle verbindet zwei Welten: Zahlen und Menschen. Du arbeitest täglich mit komplexen Preis-, Abrechnungs- und Zahlungslogiken - erfolgreich wirst du aber vor allem, weil du Menschen zusammenbringst: Support, Finance, Engineering, Partner und Leadership. Wenn du BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Ingenieurwesen studiert hast oder aus dem Consulting kommst und dich in beiden Welten wohlfühlst, passt du wahrscheinlich sehr gut zu uns, auch wenn dein Titel bisher nicht „Product Manager“ war.
 Menschen first: Du baust Vertrauen über Teams hinweg auf, hörst zu, bevor du entscheidest, und bringst Stakeholder mit unterschiedlichen Interessen an einen Tisch. Ko

title: Chief of Staff
description:
About Eye Security
 Eye Security provides cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organizations in Europe. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds, all united by a shared mission: to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players.
Founded in The Hague in 2020, Eye Security combines managed detection and response, a 24/7 human-led SOC, rapid incident response and in-house cyber insurance on a single platform. The company serves organisations across the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany and is scaling its platform and go-to-market across Europe.
Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners and TIN Capital, most recently raised a €60m Series C led by Sofina.
 The Opportunity
 As Eye Security grows, the Chief of Staff will support the leadership team in aligning priorities and translating strategy into coordinated action across the business. You will report directly to the CEO and work closely with the C-team, VPs and other senior leaders.
You will help turn company strategy into clear, coordinated execution. This includes bringing structure to leadership communication, planning, OKRs, performance reviews and cross-functional work, as well as coordinating complex strategic projects and ad hoc initiatives.
 The Role
 Connect strategy to execution. Build a detailed understanding of the company strategy, communicate its priorities clearly and work with VPs to translate them into plans for their teams.
 Coordinate strategic projects and initiatives. Bring structure to complex, cross-functional work, clarify owners and next steps and keep delivery on track through to completion.
 Strengthen the operating rhythm. Coordinate weekly and quarterly leadership routines, C-team and board meetings and follow up on decisions and actions. Build on processes that work well and improve those that need more structure.
 Support effective OKRs. Work with the CEO and VPs to clarify objectives, owners, milestones, progress reviews and feedback loops. Make it easy to see what is on track and where action is needed.
 Prepare performance reviews. Develop clear KPI reports and quarterly review materials that help leaders understand progress, gaps and next steps.
 Surface issues and decisions. Identify roadblocks, delayed decisions and commitments at risk. Assess their impact, bring the right people together, and help find a practical way forward.
 Keep leaders and stakeholders aligned. Build trusted working relationships across the business, communicate confidently with senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and maintain accountability while supporting collaboration.
 Profile
 Strong organisational and project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional work against clear milestones and timelines.
 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. You build trust and secure buy-in from senior leadership.
 Ability to work credibly with a C-team and VP group while remaining approachable and adaptable.
 Experience coordinating leadership processes, such as strategic planning, OKRs or performance reviews.
 Confidence working with KPIs and business data, turning information into clear updates and actions.
 A practical, structured approach. You follow through, keep stakeholders aligned and adapt plans when circumstances change.
 A proactive, collaborative, delivery-focused mindset, with resilience and a strong sense of ownership.
 Professional fluency in written and spoken English. Working proficiency in German or Dutch is an advantage.

 Berlin is our preferred location, though The Hague is also possible. You should be regularly present in the office and open to travelling between the two locations.
